entries.name: The Hub
entries.text: A quiet cave where every dive begins. The board on the wall keeps this journal.

entries.name: The Training Cave
entries.text: A short cave that teaches swimming, dashing and bombing, ending in a ring.

entries.name: The Shallows
entries.text: The first biome: sunlit tunnels, ledges and shafts. Find the ring to dive on.

entries.name: The Still Grotto
entries.text: A calm cave at the end of a zone. Its spring heals you and fills your jar.

entries.name: The Shell Stall
entries.text: A keeper with three pedestals in a side cave. Swim onto an item to buy it.

entries.name: Urchin
entries.text: A spiny ball that sits still on the rock. It never chases, but it hurts.

entries.name: Piranha
entries.text: A fast fish that patrols, winds up and lunges in a line. Ink it or slip past.

entries.name: Crab
entries.text: Scuttles along the rock, floor and ceiling alike. Keep your distance.

entries.name: Horned Growth
entries.text: Hard spikes that grow from the rock, floors and ceilings alike. They never move.

entries.name: Manta
entries.text: A broad ray that glides in open water and dives on you from above.

entries.name: Cannon
entries.text: A fixed turret grown into the wall. It fires slow shots along its line of sight.

entries.name: The Beholder
entries.text: Linger too long and the water turns cold. Then it drifts in through the rock.

entries.name: Giant Clam
entries.text: Opens round a pearl, shivers, then snaps shut. Grab the pearl and go.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries.text: A sleeping shell with a long arm. Dash to break its grip, or bomb it.

entries.name: Current Jet
entries.text: A rock chimney blasts water along a line of bubbles. It carries you off.

entries.name: Spike Wall
entries.text: Bone-white urchin spines grow from the rock face. Keep a body length away.

entries.name: Loose Rock
entries.text: A boulder wedged in a ledge that drops when you swim under it.

entries.name: Electric Eel
entries.text: It patrols a narrow shaft and glows just before a ring of shock spreads.

entries.name: Anemone Cluster
entries.text: Soft pink fronds on the cave floor. They sting, so swim over them.

entries.name: Plankton
entries.text: Glowing drifts of tiny life. Swim through them to gather them up.

entries.name: Fish Juice
entries.text: Blended-up fishes: it pays for spells. A zone's spring refills the jar.

entries.name: Siphon Shell
entries.text: A hollow spiral shell: sip the juice beaten creatures leak. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Ink Cloud
entries.text: A puff of ink: creatures in it, or looking through it, lose sight of you.

entries.name: Riptide
entries.text: A current from where you cast. It carries the loose: corpses, bombs, you.

entries.name: Coral Wall
entries.text: Three cells of coral grow up from the spot. They crumble after 25 s.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.text: You drop like a stone for 2 s: crush what is under you, nothing throws you.

entries.name: Lure
entries.text: A glowing bulb for 6 s: creatures that lost you swim to its light instead.

entries.name: Heavy Rune
entries.text: Set into a spell: bigger but shorter. Costs one more cast.

entries.name: Delayed Rune
entries.text: Set into a spell: it drifts off as a mote and goes off 1.5 s later.

entries.name: Lingering Rune
entries.text: Set into a spell: lasts far longer, a little weaker. One more cast.

entries.name: Cowrie
entries.text: Cave currency, worth one. A conch is five, a nautilus fifteen. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Conch
entries.text: A spiral shell worth five cowries. Barnacle clams pay out in conches.

entries.name: Nautilus
entries.text: A big striped shell worth fifteen cowries. Rare to find lying about.

entries.name: Pearl
entries.text: Worth thirty cowries; only a giant clam holds one. Take it while open.

entries.name: Moon Shell
entries.text: The rarest shell, worth fifty. Only the Swift Current brings one up.

entries.name: Bomb
entries.text: Swim clear after setting one: it breaks rock and hurts anything near, you too.

entries.name: Heart
entries.text: Sold at the Shell Stall. Restores one heart, up to your maximum.

entries.name: Bomb Pack
entries.text: Sold at the Shell Stall. Three bombs in one bundle, up to your limit.

entries.name: Flippers
entries.text: A pair of fins: you swim a fifth faster for the dive. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.text: Widens the light around you so you see more of the cave. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Shell Magnet
entries.text: A lodestone: shells within three tiles slide to you. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Bomb Bag
entries.text: Three bombs now and room for one more in stock. Carry two. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Heart Container
entries.text: One more heart, healed at once. You can carry two. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Sea-glass Goggles
entries.text: Sea-glass in kelp rims: buried treasure shows through rock. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Urchin Cap
entries.text: An urchin shell worn spines out: a dash spikes what it hits. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Clam
entries.text: A sleeping clam with something shiny inside. A dash, bomb or ink cracks it.

entries.name: Clay Pot
entries.text: An old pot on the cave floor. A dash, blast or ink shatters it for shells.

entries.name: Barnacle Clam
entries.text: Touch a barnacle clam and it creaks open on shells. Not every one is friendly.

entries.name: Hidden Pocket
entries.text: A rock tile with a hairline crack or a faint glint, hollow inside. Bomb it open.

entries.name: Buried Treasure
entries.text: Shells, bombs, even gear sealed in solid rock. Faint flecks give some away.

entries.name: The Relic
entries.text: A stone octopus idol worth 25 shells. Lift it and the ceiling starts to fall.

entries.name: Swift Current
entries.text: Reach the whirlpool by the time under the level name for a moon shell.

entries.name: Marlo, the Stranded Diver
entries.text: Sealed in a pocket of rock, calling for help. Bomb him free, again and again.

lines: Calls out from a pocket of rock in the first caves.
Freed once. He waits in the hub.
Freed twice. The tide keeps burying him.
Freed in three runs. A new ring in the hub floor leads to Shallows 1-3.
extra: Kept his word: met you further down a dive, with salvage.
You killed him. He was gone for a run.

entries.name: Pip, the Caged Critter
entries.text: A small friend caged in a side cave. Break the bars and he follows you.

lines: Locked in a cage in a side cave.
The bars broke and he followed you out. He swims in the hub now.
extra: Out exploring the Shallows now. He finds shiny things.
His mother found you further down a dive. She does not forget.
You killed him. He was gone for a run.

entries.name: The Shopkeeper
entries.text: A hermit crab selling whatever washes up, three things at a time.

lines: Runs a stall in a side cave of the Shallows. Shells only.

entries.name: The Sunken Wreck
entries.text: A ship that never made it home. A barnacle clam and pots fill its hold.

entries.name: The Urchin Garden
entries.text: Low mounds on the cave floor where urchins grow in rows. Never swim between.

entries.name: The Jet Gauntlet
entries.text: A long tube of vents that blow along their bubbles. Ride them or fight them.

entries.name: Cave Fish
entries.text: Harmless little fish that drift in schools. They never bite.

entries.name: Rune Carving
entries.text: Old marks cut into the rock face. Nobody remembers who made them, or why.

entries.name: Fossil
entries.text: A shell, a fish or a bone pressed into thick rock long before the water came.

entries.name: Fish-bone Wall
entries.text: Packed fish bones. A dash, shot or blast crumbles it, often opening a shortcut.

entries.name: Wall Bush
entries.text: Stubborn little growths that cling to the cave wall.

entries.name: Cave Weed
entries.text: Tall glowing weed that sways on floors and ceilings. It lights up the dark.

entries.name: Round Boulder
entries.text: A smooth old stone half sunk into the floor. It stays put, whatever you do.

entries.name: Quill, the Collector
entries.text: A fussy old octopus who trades in lost things. He wants the old octopus idols.

lines: Moved into the hub. Wants the old octopus idols, carried out through the ring.
One relic handed over. A shelf entry unlocked.
Three relics. His lantern lights every dive.
extra: Out on a dig in the Shallows now and then.
Met you in the Still Grotto with fresh fish juice.
You killed him. He was gone for a run.

entries.name: The Challenge Pool
entries.text: Pay five shells, last twenty seconds of falling rocks, and a clam rises.

entries.name: The Pool Host
entries.text: An old sea horse who runs the Challenge Pool and cheers each wager.

lines: Runs the wager in the round basin. Five shells, twenty seconds, one clam.
Moved into the hub after your first won wager.
extra: Paid the house's debt further down a dive.
You killed him. The pool sat empty for a run.

entries.name: Shelf Piece: The Grin
entries.text: The first idol on Quill's shelf. It has not stopped smiling since.

entries.name: Shelf Piece: The Frown
entries.text: The second relic Quill took, and the one he likes least.

entries.name: Shelf Piece: The Stare
entries.text: The third relic, the one that makes the lantern burn. It watches the hub.
